newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudis keep trade guessing over barley tender date.
newsitem.headline: Saudis keep trade guessing over barley tender date.

text.p: Saudi Arabia, the largest world buyer of feed barley, has yet to officially launch a tender for the import of 500,000 tonnes of optional-origin barley, European grain traders said on Monday.
Last week exporters said Saudi Arabia was in the market to import 500,000 tonnes of optional barley for February delivery onwards.
But they said that Saudi Arabia was likely to officially tender for the grain this month.
They explained the kingdom needed to secure the barley for its large sheep herd ahead of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan that starts in mid-January.

Saudi Arabia may import an estimated 3.9 million tonnes of barley in the 1996/97 against 3.2 million tonnes in the previous season, latest estimates from the International Grains Council suggest. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
